title: Reorganize String with No Adjacent Duplicates

monster.name: Entropy Drake
monster.title: Separator of Adjacent Monograms
monster.defeatQuote: String rearranged so no two adjacent letters match!

description: Given a string `s`, rearrange the characters of `s` so that any two adjacent characters are not the same. Return any possible rearrangement of `s` or `""` if not possible.
solutionCode:
def reorganizeString(s: str) -> str:
    from collections import Counter
    import heapq
    counts = Counter(s)
    if max(counts.values()) > (len(s) + 1) // 2: return ""
    pq = [(-cnt, ch) for ch, cnt in counts.items()]
    heapq.heapify(pq)
    res = []
    prev_cnt, prev_ch = 0, ''
    while pq:
        cnt, ch = heapq.heappop(pq)
        res.append(ch)
        if prev_cnt < 0:
            heapq.heappush(pq, (prev_cnt, prev_ch))
        prev_cnt, prev_ch = cnt + 1, ch
    return "".join(res)
hints: Max-heap by letter frequency. Always pull the most frequent letter that is not equal to the previous character.
